purpose: Verify the integrity and arithmetic of 98 individually priced independent IP-asset records. CAUSORYN occupies TA-IP-097; the new TA-IP-098 is the implemented Software Asset Engineering Platform / Octavia v0.1.0. Website repositories remain excluded digital displays.

verification.browserIntegrity: The public renderer fetches the valuation register and methodology as raw text, recomputes SHA-256 in the browser and compares the result with this attestation.
verification.valuationReconciliation: The public renderer assembles the current asset register, applies published overrides, recalculates asset-level analytical economics and compares aggregate values with the published portfolio totals.
verification.publicSiteDirectory: The public project-site enhancer recomputes the SHA-256 digest of the site directory before presenting its integrity state.
verification.existenceBoundary: The timestamped public publication and matching digests demonstrate existence and integrity of the public commercial record as published. They do not independently prove authorship, legal title, patent priority, source-code identity, scientific validity, security assurance, certified valuation or commercial outcome.
verification.futureEconomicReferences: The renderer verifies the current 98-asset register. Numeric maturity sensitivities require each asset’s own established monetary baseline.
verification.sellerReadiness: Verify the dated criteria disclosure and corrected readiness records. Integrity checks establish unchanged published bytes and cross-register consistency; they do not establish completed transfer gates or independent certification.
verification.rightsTransfer: The public renderer verifies the seller-readiness, IP-ownership, software supply-chain, portfolio audit and rights-transfer records. The public transaction layer focuses on the offered rights, third-party obligations and transfer perimeter rather than internal development methods.
verification.projectEvaluations: Each of the 98 IP assets has its own evaluation, first-party rights and transfer perimeter. Scope corrections are dated separately from the retained source-evidence assessment. The current targeted review retains all other 96 asset assessments and their evidence dates.
verification.projectIdentities: Confirm the unique TA-IP-001 through TA-IP-098 identifiers against the same project title, reference alias and slug in every current register and digital-display entry.
verification.projectConnections: Verify the proposed-connection register, resolve every member against its independent TA-IP asset record, reject project reuse across combinations and recompute both the combined asking reference and recreation-cost total from the current individual financial references. This verifies identities, unique allocation and arithmetic; it does not establish technical integration.

privacyBoundary: Public records expose seller-side commercial, rights, transfer, evidence and non-sensitive supply-chain metadata only. Internal development methods, proprietary know-how, credentials, customer data, sensitive implementation details and transaction-confidential material remain outside the public showroom.
